# Sajda 4.5.3
### Patch release - **Adhan while it sounds:** the prayer row no longer swaps its mute toggle for a stop button — a quiet **Dismiss** link appears beside the prayer name (underlined on hover) and stops the adhan. **Stop Adhan** also moved into the footer row, left of About. - **Time correction now re-arms the adhan:** changing a prayer's time (or any recalculation that moves it) counts as a new occurrence, so the corrected prayer sounds again instead of being swallowed by the played-once dedup for the rest of the session. - **Sound check plays the full adhan:** Settings → Adhan Sound preview no longer cuts off after a few seconds — and restarting it can no longer be killed by a previous sample's leftover auto-stop. The stop glyph reverts when the sample ends on its own, and now follows the red alert colour while a prayer is imminent. - **Settings:** Time Correction moved above the collapsed Calculation accordion — one click instead of two. - Website: refreshed minimal design (white, black buttons, app-icon favicon).
